posts.name: mahipps
posts.cooked:
I got tired of rolling dice and trying to figure out an easy way to pick 4 random heros from a group of 10, so I wrote a quick javascript app to do it for me!

If anyone wants to use it, here’s the link:

http://bit.ly/sotmrandom

Right now it’s just the stock art from the website, but I may change that up. Also, if anyone associated with the game has an issue with this and wants me to take it down, just say the word and I’ll make it happen. I’m not looking to make any money off of this, just starting out as a developer so basically anytime I’m confronted with a problem I see if I can code out the solution.

Thanks. Feedback is welcomed!

posts.name: mahipps
posts.cooked:
Hmmm… I believe that given 10 heroes to choose from and choosing 5 of them at random and ignoring order there are 252 distinct possible sets. But I haven’t taken stats in MANY years. Anyway there’s about a 1 in 250 chance of getting the Freedom 5 at random.

10! / (5! *5!) = 252
